title: In court dress (prologue)
prompt:

Seen in profile facing right, the same scale and proportions as every other prince- sprite (match prince-stand: cap-of-helmet to chin is one ninth of a standing figure). Generate exactly ONE isolated sprite, no model sheet or labels. Use transparent background. Canvas aspect ratio 220:360, target delivery 220 x 360 pixels. Show the full silhouette. Keep the prince's face, proportions, costume and scale consistent with the reference. Asset prince-court.
